# A strong paired-current comparator: identical complete density law

30 October 2026. Root reconstruction of an ordinary linear mechanism, informed
by the direct paired-current predecessors. The result is useful selection
information, not a claim that pairing currents or projecting Gaussian noise is
new. The physical variables here are signed harmonic density/charge fluctuations,
not nonnegative particles or the exclusion process of the other theorem.

## 1. Actual harmonic current operation

Let x in R^N have conserved sum zero and let (B j)_i=j_(i-1)-j_i on a ring.
An actual reversible current bath with symmetric positive semidefinite mobility C
is specified by

    dJ=-(1/2)C B^T x dt + sqrt(C) dW,
    dx=B dJ.                                                (1)

The matching drift and noise are both parts of the operation. Merely adding
anticorrelated noise while leaving an incompatible dissipative response does
not supply (1). The invariant state law is the unit Gaussian on sum x=0,
because the state drift is -(1/2)B C B^T x and its noise covariance is B C B^T.
It may be initialized at this law or at any explicitly supplied common x_0
when comparing complete state paths. White noise is an ideal rate model, not
a finite-bandwidth apparatus claim.

For each bond pair (b,b+r), put v_(b,r)=e_b-e_(b+r). It produces equal and
opposite physical bond currents. Give each pair an independent scalar bath,
with covariance weight s(N-1)/(2NR), and the corresponding reversible force
response. The resulting physical mobility is

    C_R=[s(N-1)/(2NR)] sum_(r=1)^R sum_b v_(b,r)v_(b,r)^T.   (2)

All pair currents sum to zero, including their drift, so

    sum_b J_b(t)=0                                          (3)

on every path, when initial integrated currents are zero. The active coupling
range is R (or its circular counterpart); a pair separated by a macroscopic
fraction of the ring is a nonlocal operation. No sensor is presumed to create
that operation for free.

# Why a local large-memory fluctuation construction does not replace the full law

30 October 2026. Root consequence of the complementary elastic-counter
architecture. It uses only its pathwise physical-current relation and capacity,
not a guessed equilibration time or a limiting Gaussian calculation.

Let x be the real harmonic density field, J the complete signed bond current,
and z the actual per-bond elastic counters. The supplied local architecture
obeys, including any reflecting-boundary forces,

    dx=B dJ,   dz=dJ,   |z_i|<=b_N,
    (B j)_i=j_(i-1)-j_i.                                (1)

Thus x-Bz is an exact conserved vector. This is stronger than the total-counter
premise in the general locality theorem; the following conclusion applies to
this per-bond architecture and is not asserted for every local controller.

Set k=2pi/N, d=exp(ik)-1, and define the macroscopic fundamental density mode

    xi_N(t)=N^-1 sum_i exp(iki)x_i(t).

Exact continuity gives, on every path and at every actual time,

    xi_N(t)-xi_N(0)
      =(d/N)sum_i exp(iki)[z_i(t)-z_i(0)],
    |xi_N(t)-xi_N(0)|<=2b_N|d|<=4pi b_N/N.              (2)

For b_N=sqrt(N)(log N)^2, the bound tends to zero uniformly over all time,
although the corresponding fluctuation-mode allowance
sqrt(N)|xi_N(t)-xi_N(0)|<=4pi(log N)^2 diverges. There is consequently no conflict
between ordinary order-one Gaussian fluctuation evolution and a frozen
macroscopic density Fourier mode.

This separates three precision objectives:

| Objective | Consequence of this architecture |
|---|---|
| Stationary one-time visible law | May be exactly the supplied Gaussian marginal |
| Typical density fluctuation paths on N^2 time | May approach the ordinary OU path law when the prepared memory susceptibility grows |
| Order-one density-profile relaxation or complete speed-N history law | Cannot agree with ordinary heat relaxation for b_N=o(N), by (2) |

mode retains that mode up to o(1) for all times. The ordinary harmonic heat
bath changes it by a fixed fraction on physical N^2T. Even with stationary
Gaussian initialization, an event requiring an order-one change between two
specified macroscopic density modes becomes impossible for sufficiently large

# Local reversible counters with prepared elastic memory

30 October 2026. Constructive complementary result. This is a harmonic continuous-current model, in the same mathematical class as root's Gaussian paired-current comparator. It is not a counterexample inside the bounded-occupation jump class of the locality theorem. It pays growing memory capacity and prepared long-wavelength memory susceptibility while keeping runtime interactions local and the dynamics reversible.

## 1. Result and objective actually achieved

There is a local reversible current bath with bounded memory coordinates z_i such that:

1. Its exact stationary visible law is the unit Gaussian on the zero-sum density subspace, for every finite N.
2. All physical currents, including constraint reactions, satisfy dz=dJ and dx=B dJ. Hence the complete total current is bounded by 2N b_N at every time.
3. With b_N=sqrt(N)[log(N+1)]^2=o(N), every fixed nonzero macroscopic circulation J_total/N^2 is eventually impossible.
4. On physical horizons N^2T, the entire stationary Gaussian density-fluctuation path converges to the ordinary diffusive Ornstein--Uhlenbeck field. The joint leading circulation CLT also remains ordinary.

The construction therefore preserves a meaningful complete **fluctuation path limit**, not the full finite-N density-path law or its speed-N large-deviation action. Its CLT circulation is not suppressed. The difference between typical path limits and rare-history laws is essential here.
